posts.name: MarioFanaticXV
posts.cooked:
Trying out new heroes is always my favorite part of an expansion (except Villains of the Multiverse, for obvious reasons). There's no particular hero I'm looking forward to the most, but with 11 new ones coming to us and a bunch of extra promos, I think it's safe to say that Oblivaeon will make me very happy in the end.

If I had to pick just one hero deck I'm most excited to play with, I think it'd be Luminary- mad scientists are always fun, and it's why Tachyon is one of my favorite heroes. Yes, I consider her a mad scientist, no, mad does not necessarily mean evil- my favorite example of any mad scientist is actually not a villain at all, but rather Doc Brown from Back to the Future.

posts.name: riff.freelance
posts.cooked:
Oh, man where to begin?

Harpy and a "full" 5 man Nightwatch team. This just screams fun.

The Mission deck and what we hope it contains. The Gate heroes, Ennead members, nifty new gear?!?! Who knows what fun it holds!!!

11 new heroes. For me heroes are the meat and potatoes to any Sentinels product, this is where the fun is had. There will be so much to do with them even outside "Oblivaeon mode." Versus evil self grudge matches, new team themes, Void Guard teamed with the Southwest Sentinels. This is just going to be so much fun! Add the promos with this point. New Omnitron X and Skyscraper. New Visionary and Ra. New Prime Wardens and Freedom Five. So much nifty. 

Oddly I'm also excited that this is the end. It's bittersweet, but it also opens up new avenues. Greater Than Games can dedicate more energy to it's next big project and it's other Sentinels stuff. Fan made stuff will be able to be talked about somewhere (maybe even here.) Massive speculation and hopefully official answers to our outstanding questions.
